verdict: HISTORICAL SNAPSHOT ONLY. Do not use this record for current admission; the corrective audit and cleanup ledger are authoritative.

items.name: 90-GB envelope proven
items.evidence: The prior 73.3-GB statement was not a live incremental allocation proof. Current cleanup leaves a 57,520,898,007-byte model/artifact/proof ledger, while a new parallel or parent-stream admission still requires live allocation evidence.

items.name: Qwen sweep
items.measured: decode 33.6 ms/token, prefill 36.2 ms/token at the best batched setting, 435 dispatches/forward
items.why_not_deeper: llama.cpp reaches 19.33 ms/token on the identical file, so TG20 is physically reachable and the 1.74x is entirely software. Closing it is kernel work, not measurement.

items.name: Llama transfer
items.result: K0 passes; 90.9x slower on decode and 1809x on prefill; no rung claimed and no kernel promoted
items.reason: llama.rs is a 647-line correctness reference with no command buffer, arena, batched prefill or fused kernels. The gap is an absent pipeline, not a defect.

items.name: Admitted MoE proof
items.progress: four causes eliminated by measurement: position/slot/seq_len bookkeeping, frozen routing, the autotuned GEMM schedule, and confinement to the routed path. Dispatch counting wired: 589 per forward.
items.blocker: the next step is a numerics bisect and there is no reference to bisect against. deepseek_v2 has no CPU forward; mla_decode hard-errors off Metal; the legacy path was retired at the rename.

items.name: Deepest honest per-model TG rungs
items.external_baseline: llama-bench on the identical files, same box, same session
items.caveat: every number taken with the 24h substrate run live and recorded as contended. Contention cannot make a failed rung look passed, so the direction is conservative.

items.name: Gravity/Condense speed frontier
items.blocker: Receipt-bound .gravity artifacts are present under /tmp/hawking-tg-artifacts, but they are source-preserving/non-promoting receipts; a capable reduced representation and live clean-lease timing are still missing.

items.name: Stronger adapter matrix
items.result: qwen correct and fast, llama correct and demoted with the structural reason, deepseek admitted and wrong with four causes eliminated. The BOS defect that presented as three broken adapters was one bug, fixed at the tokenizer.

items.name: All non-parent Ramanujan paths integration-ready
items.after: roles, all seven stores, search, Forge, sovereignty, economics, limits, the train package and the whole data pipeline restored from 8b0c5405^; 146 tests pass
still_unbuilt: repair controller (its 800-record D4 corpus exists and now reproduces)
items.blocked_not_unfinished: Q1 has no definition anywhere in this repo or in the mission document. Q2 exists only as a purpose line. A contract cannot be written against an undefined gate without inventing the requirement first.

items.name: Exact final parent revision, rotation, representation, auctions, gates, Odyssey sequence and executable restream command
items.status: EIGHT OF NINE PARTS WRITTEN, COMMAND NOT RUNNABLE
items.written: parent b4734de4 with 282 shards and its sealed manifest, N-1 seal-evict rotation with measured costs, six preregistered arms with three nulls at a strict 1.0 complete-BPW ceiling, eviction and escape gates, and the Odyssey sequence with each missing prerequisite named
items.blocker: the capability gate is keyed by artifact content hash and refuses anything unlisted. Every candidate is REFUSED by name or absent, and absent is UNVERIFIED, which is also refused.

the_one_decision_that_moves_the_most: rebuilding a .gravity artifact, or running the preregistered representation tournament which produces one as output. That unblocks item 6 outright and item 9's command, and it is the only remaining lever that is not kernel engineering.
recurring_defect_class: this campaign's characteristic failure is a gate that cannot fail correctly. A quality gate that passed by skipping. A golden that pinned no input. A dispatch counter one engine populated, printing 0 where it meant 'unset'. A Q0 receipt whose harness had been deleted. Five test files that errored at collection and took 1575 cases down with them. A freeze sealed by a file hash that embeds a timestamp. Each was found by making the instrument report honestly rather than by finding the bug it was hiding.
